description: This source file defines a custom convention for ASP.NET Core MVC controllers, grouping API endpoints by version based on route attributes.

classes.name: GroupByApiRootConvention
classes.description: Implements IControllerModelConvention to assign group names to controllers based on their route attribute, facilitating API version grouping.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Modifies the ControllerModel to set its ApiExplorer.GroupName according to the route template's version segment.
